content_md:
As of now it's easier to vibe code a data serializer than a user interface if the semantics are established, and we have API access through browser-use regardless of API. So, picking the right/best interaction surface for the task is likely the best strategy. 

For example, its actually a better idea to use Apple Notes if people like those aesthetics because it's quite easy to cook up an Apple Script to serialize the notes with metadata into Obsidian files later on when preference change.
